1.w: Oh, that my head were waters, and my eyes a fountain of tears, that I might weep day and night [for] the slain of the daughter of my people!

2.w: Who will give me in the wilderness a lodging place for travelers, that I might leave my people and depart from them, for they [are] all adulterers, an assembly of treacherous ones.

3.w: “And they bend their tongues [like] their bow [in] deception, and they are not mighty for the truth on the earth; for they proceed from evil to evil, and they do not know Me!” A declaration of YHWH.

4.w: “[Let] each man take heed of his neighbor, and in any brother not trust. For every brother does utterly supplant, and every neighbor walks in slander.

5.w: And each man will deceive his neighbor, and they will not speak the truth; they have taught their tongue to speak deception, and they weary themselves to commit iniquity.

6.w: You dwell in the midst of deceit, [for] in deceit they refuse to know Me!” A declaration of YHWH.

7.w: Therefore thus says YHWH of Hosts: “Behold, I am refining them, and I will test them! For how shall I act before the face of the daughter of My people?

8.w: Their tongue [is] a slaughtering arrow, speaking deceit; with his mouth he speaks peace to his neighbor, and within himself he sets an ambush.

9.w: Shall I not visit them for these things? A declaration of YHWH. On a nation such as this shall not My soul avenge itself?”

10.w: Over the mountains I will take up weeping and wailing, and over the pastures of the wilderness a lamentation, because they are burned up without man passing through, and they do not hear the voice of the cattle; from the birds of the heavens even to the beast they have fled; they have gone away.

11.w: “And I will make Jerusalem into heaps, a dwelling for jackals; and the cities of Judah I will make a desolation, without inhabitant.”

12.w: Who [is] the wise man that he may understand this? And to whom has the mouth of YHWH spoken, that he may declare it? Because of what has the land perished [and] burned up like a wilderness, without one passing through?

13.w: And YHWH said: “Because they have forsaken My law that I had set before their face, and they have not listened to My voice and have not walked by it.

14.w: And they have walked after the stubborness of their own heart, and after the Baals, which their fathers taught them.

15.w: Therefore thus says YHWH of Hosts, the God of Israel: “Behold, I will feed them—this people—with wormwood, and give them to drink water of gall!

16.w: And I will scatter them among the nations that have known, neither they [nor] their fathers, and I will send out after them a sword, until I have put an end to them!

17.w: Thus says YHWH of Hosts: “Consider, and call for the wailing women, that they may come; and send for the skillful women, that they may come!

18.w: And let them hurry and take up for us a lament, that our eyes may overflow with tears, and our eyelids flow with water.

19.w: For a voice of wailing is heard from Zion: ‘How devastated we are! We are exceedingly ashamed, because we have left behind the land, because they have thrown down our dwellings!’”

20.w: Now hear, O women, the word of YHWH, and let your⁺ ear receive the word of His mouth! And teach your⁺ daughters a lamentation, and each woman her neighbor a dirge!

21.w: For death has come up into our windows; it enters into our fortresses, to cut off the child from outside, the young men from the squares.

22.w: Speak thus: A declaration of YHWH—“The corpse of a man will fall like dung upon the face of the field, and like sheaves behind the reaper, and there shall be no one gathering!”

23.w: Thus says YHWH: “Let not the wise one glory in his wisdom, and let not the mighty one glory in his might, and let not the rich one glory in his riches;

24.w: that but let the one glorying glory in this, understanding and knowing Me, that I [am] YHWH, exercising loving devotion, justice, and righteousness in the earth; for in these [things] I delight!” A declaration of YHWH.

25.w: “Behold, the days are coming,” a declaration of YHWH, “When I will visit upon all the circumcised in the foreskin—

26.w: upon Egypt, and upon Judah, and upon Edom, and upon the sons of Ammon, and upon Moab, and upon all those cutting off a corner, those dwelling in the desert; for all the nations [are] uncircumcised, and all the house of Israel [are] uncircumcised in the heart.
